hub.title: OFD Toolbox
hub.description: Ten browser-based OFD utilities — convert, merge, compress, read, and export without uploading files to a server.

ofdMerge.title: Merge OFD
ofdMerge.desc: Combine multiple OFD files into one

ofdToImage.title: OFD to Image
ofdToImage.desc: Export OFD pages as PNG or JPG

ofdToSvg.title: OFD to SVG
ofdToSvg.desc: Vector export for each OFD page

ofdReader.title: OFD Reader
ofdReader.desc: Preview OFD pages in the browser

ofdToLongImage.title: OFD to Long Image
ofdToLongImage.desc: Stitch all pages into one vertical image

workspace.uploadMultiHint: Select multiple OFD files to merge
workspace.fileReady: File uploaded — click the action button to process.
workspace.progressPartialRaster: Some pages used fallback rendering — output may be incomplete.

workspace.error: Could not process this OFD file. Please try another file.
workspace.errorNeedMultiple: Please select at least two OFD files to merge.
workspace.errorMergeFailed: Could not merge these OFD files. Ensure each file is valid and try selecting all files at once.

workspace.errorNoText: No extractable text was found in this OFD file.

workspace.trustSub: Your privacy is our top priority. Unlike other online tools, we never upload your OFD files to any server. Everything is processed instantly inside your web browser.
workspace.trustCheck1: Zero Server Uploads: Sensitive data never leaves your device.
workspace.trustCheck2: 100% Safe: Perfect for confidential business contracts, invoices, and personal OFD documents.
workspace.trustCheck3: Instant Speed: No queueing or waiting for server downloads.
